currentHost.evidence: No CNAME, Pages publication workflow, Pages source configuration, or Vercel/Netlify/Cloudflare/Firebase hosting configuration is present. The repository does not identify the external historical beta provider or URL.
currentHost.remainingAction: Owner must identify the historical beta hostname/provider and confirm its platform mapping before any hosting action.

currentBetaUrlClassification.evidence: The URL itself is not stored in the repository. Every non-local, non-allowlisted hostname is treated as historical/closed.
currentBetaUrlClassification.remainingAction: Record the old beta hostname as owner evidence without reopening it.

betaClosureMechanism.evidence: index.html gridlyHostnameGate executes at runtime before app paint. It lowercases location.hostname; localhost, 127.0.0.1, gridlygo.com, www.gridlygo.com, and preview.gridlygo.com may continue. Every other/unknown hostname redirects to ./beta-closed.html. Query strings are preserved except redirect-like parameters. beta-closed.html registers ./service-worker.js at ./ scope and removes recognized old Gridly caches.
betaClosureMechanism.remainingAction: Keep the historical hostname outside the explicit production-candidate allowlist.

hostDifferentiation.evidence: One static artifact behaves differently by exact runtime hostname; unknown hosts fail closed and local development remains available.
hostDifferentiation.remainingAction: Add any future candidate hostname only through governed review and deterministic tests.

recommendedProductionHost.evidence: GitHub Pages is the smallest repository-aligned option: the application is static, uses relative paths, includes an explicit GitHub Pages compatibility audit, and needs no server-side SPA rewrite for the current single-page root entry. No Pages publisher is currently configured.
recommendedProductionHost.remainingAction: Owner must select/configure GitHub Pages and obtain current account/repository-specific custom-domain instructions before DNS or deployment.

recommendedValidationHost.evidence: preview.gridlygo.com is allowlisted as the distinct validation candidate and keeps gridlygo.com reserved for eventual launch. It must serve the same artifact. A reachable URL is distribution under the unchanged governance boundary; noindex or obscurity is not access control.
recommendedValidationHost.remainingAction: Obtain explicit Deployment and Distribution authorization before publishing the preview origin.

hostingDecision.why: Static relative-path PWA plus existing GitHub Pages compatibility logic; avoids an unsupported migration.

deploymentWorkflow.trigger: NOT_CONFIGURED_FOR_WEB; only Capacitor Validation runs on pull_request and workflow_dispatch
deploymentWorkflow.source: Repository-root static assets; no publishing artifact is currently produced
deploymentWorkflow.productionBranch: main (authoritative policy; no web publisher configured)
deploymentWorkflow.rollbackMethod: NOT_CONFIGURED; after authorization, prefer redeploying a reviewed prior main commit/artifact. Rollback remains NOT_AUTHORIZED.

manifest.evidence: manifest.json uses Gridly/Gridly, standalone, relative ./ start_url and scope, relative 192/512 icons, #020812 background and #06101f theme. These values are origin-portable.
manifest.remainingAction: Validate installability on authorized HTTPS origins.

serviceWorker.evidence: js/app.js registers ./service-worker.js with ./ scope. The worker is same-origin only, navigation network-first with no-store and cached ./index.html fallback; listed closure shell assets are cache-first.
serviceWorker.remainingAction: Do not broaden scope. Validate the production candidate online; full offline app operation is not claimed.

cacheSafety.evidence: Cache name gridly-pwa-shell-lp1011-v1 and version lp101.1-runtime-recovery are unchanged. Service-worker storage is origin-scoped, so old-beta caches cannot cross into gridlygo.com or preview.gridlygo.com. A fresh candidate origin requires no cache-version bump. On the old origin, activation deletes other gridly-pwa-shell-* and gridly-beta-closure-* caches; navigation refreshes index from network when available.
cacheSafety.remainingAction: If the worker bytes or precache contract later change, issue a reviewed deterministic version/cache-name increment; no global cache clearing is required now.

metadata.evidence: Description/theme/mobile metadata exist, but canonical URL, Open Graph URL/image metadata, social metadata, robots policy, and sitemap are absent. The visible shell still contains Liberty County Beta branding.
metadata.remainingAction: After launch/legal authorization, add reviewed canonical/share/SEO metadata and remove beta branding in a separately authorized presentation change.

absoluteUrls.evidence: Core PWA files and local assets use relative URLs. External runtime dependencies/API endpoints are HTTPS. No old beta URL or host-specific redirect target is stored.
absoluteUrls.remainingAction: Re-audit third-party availability and policy before deployment.
